book.name: Mariko
book.title: Amangʼana Amazomu ga Yeesu Krisito kyeego gakaamirwe na Mariko

content: Yeesu arasemwa embere wa Pirato

Hano kwakiiri ego, ekiina kyoosi kya abhakuru bha abhaseengeri, abhakaruka bha Abhayahudi, na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa, bhakiikara hamwe, bhakakora obhuzaabhi. Bhakamubhoha Yeesu, bhakamuhira ku Pirato.
Pirato akamubhuurya Yeesu, “Awe naawe omutemi wa Abhayahudi?” Yeesu akamukyoora, “Naawe ogaambiri.”
Abhakuru bha abhaseengeri bhaari bharamuzoongera Yeesu kubha, akoriri amabhi maaru.
Pirato akamubhuurya kweeki, akabhuga, “Otakukyoora ryoryoosi? Rora kyeego bhakukuzoongera kumabhiihu maaru.”
Nawe Yeesu ataamukyooriri ryoryoosi. Niho Pirato akaruguura.
Pirato ariikirirya Yeesu yiitwe
Eriibhaga rye Enyaangi yo Okuhiita, Pirato yaari arabhiigurira omubhohwa wumwe, wuno abhaatu bhaamusabhiri ahaatirwe.
Eriibhaga riyo munyuumba ya abhabhohwa bhaari bhariho abhaatu bhano bhaakoriri obhwaangi no obhwiiti mubhwaangi bhwaabhu. Owumwe wa abhiiti bhayo yaari arabhirikirwa Baraaba.
Esaango ekuru ya abhaatu bhakagya ku Pirato, bhakamusabha abhiigurire omubhohwa wumwe, kyeego akanara kukora.
Pirato akabhabhuurya, “Bhoono, mureenda nibhiigurire omutemi wa Abhayahudi?”
Akabhuga ego kwo okubha akamenya kubha abhakuru bha abhaseengeri bhaamugwaatirye Yeesu kweewe, kwiiguru yo omugono gwaabhu ogweene ego.
Niho abhakuru bha abhaseengeri bhakasiigirirya esaango ya abhaatu yirya, emusabhe Pirato abhiigurire Baraaba.
Pirato akabhabhuurya kweeki, “Bhoono ambe, mureenda nikoreki omuutu wuno mukugaamba ni mutemi wa Abhayahudi?”
Abhaatu bhoosi bhakiitabha kwe ekituri kweeki, bhakabhuga, “Mumubhaambe kumusaraba!”
Pirato akabhabhuurya, “Akoriri isaryaki rino rigirirye abhaambwe kumusaraba?” Niho ebho bhakahaara bhukongʼu okutema ekituri, bhakabhuga, “Mumubhaambe kumusaraba!”
Pirato yaari areenda okuyizomeerya esaango ya abhaatu, kweego akabhiigurira Baraaba. Kyaamwe, akaswaagya bhamuteme Yeesu emijariti. Kimwe akaragania agegwe, atemererwe kumusaraba.
Abhasirikare bharamuzibhura Yeesu
Abhasirikare bhakamugega Yeesu, bhakagya neewe mukiina ekikuru munyuumba yo omwaanaangwa Pirato. Bhakakumania abhasirikare abhaandi bhoosi.
Bhakamwiibhohya Yeesu omweenda gwe ezambaraau yo obhutemi. Bhakoogosa orusuurya rwa amahwa, bhakamwiibhohya kumutwe.
Bhakataanga okumukeerya kwe enzeero, “Kasiinga rugabho, omutemi wa Abhayahudi!”
Bhaari bharamutema kumutwe na maara no okumutweera amate, bhaari bharamuhigamira kwo okumukumya.
Hano abhasirikare bhayo bhaamariri okumuzibhura, bhakamuruusya omweenda gwe ezambaraau yirya, no okumwiibhohya kweeki eziingibho zyaaye. Kyaamwe, bhakagya neewe okumubhaamba kumusaraba.
Yeesu arabhaambwa kumusaraba

Munzira, bhakasikana no omuutu wuno yaari arahita mumugye okurwa mumuguundu, eriina ryaaye Simooni, yaari omwiikari wa Kirene. Omuutu wurya yaari wiise waabhu Arekizanda na Rufo. Abhasirikare bhakamusingʼirirya okugega omusaraba gwa Yeesu.
Bhakamuhira Yeesu hano haabhirikiirwe Gorigota, obhugazuro bhwaku ni Kihaanga kyo Omutwe.
Bhakamuha Yeesu amaanzi go omuzabibu gano bhasaangiinie na manemane,
nawe ewe akaanga okunywa.
Niho bhakamubhaamba kumusaraba, na bhakatwaana eziingibho zyaaye. Bhakatema obhwiitoori ni weewi araagege ngibhoki.
Eriibhaga rya katatu etabhoori, niho bhaamubhaambiri kumusaraba.
Kumusaraba bhakatuura amakaamo go obhuzoongeri bhwaaye, gaari garabhuga, “Omutemi wa Abhayahudi.”
Bhakamubhaamba hamwe na abhateesya abhabhiri kumisaraba, owumwe orubhaara rwaaye rwo obhuryo no owuundi orubhaara rwo obhumosi. [
Niho gakakuunaana Amakaamo Amahoreeru gano gakubhuga, “Akabharwa hamwe na abhatemya bhe ebhibhi.”
Abhaatu bhano bhaari bhakuhita kunzira yiyo, bhaari bharamutuka kwo okusiingisya emitwe gyaabhu, bharabhuga, “Aa! Awe, okabhuga oragwiisya eriiseengerero no okwoomboka kwa siku isatu!
Bhoono, wiituurye omweene, wiike okurwa kumusaraba hayo!”
Na abhakuru bha abhaseengeri na abheegya bhe emigiro gya Musa bhoosi kwa hamwe, bhakamuzibhura bharabhuga, “Akatuurya abhaandi, nawe atakunagya kwiituurya omweene!

Angu, ewe abhugiri kubha niwe Masiya, omutemi wa Abhiiziraeri. Bhoono turore yiike kumusaraba, okubha tumurore no okumwiikirirya!” Naabhe abhaatu bhano bhaabhaambirwe hamwe neewe kumisaraba, nabho bhaari bharamutuka.
Okukwa kwa Yeesu
Ambe, kweemera eriibhaga rya kasaasabha mumwiisi, ekiirima kikasikira mukyaaro kyoosi tee eriibhaga rya keenda.
Niho eriibhaga rya keenda, Yeesu akarira kwe eriiraka ikuru akabhuga, “Eri, Eri! Rama sabakitani?” Obhugazuro bhwaku ni, “Ee Taatabhugya waane, ee Taatabhugya waane, ndora onitigiri?”
Abhaatu abharebhe gati wa bhano bhiimeereeri harya, hano bhakiigwa aragaamba, bhakabhuga, “Mwiigwe bhamure, aramubhirikira omurooti Eriya.”

Omuutu owumwe akaryaara bhwaangu, akaaza ne epaamba, akayiitobhya mumaanzi amaruru go omuzabibu gari musuka, akayituura kumaara. Akagororokya iguru, okubha amuhe Yeesu anywe. Omuutu wuyo akabhuga, “Tiga otamuha! Turore eraabhe Eriya araaza okumwiikya kumusaraba hayo!”
Yeesu akarira kwe eriiraka ikuru, kyaamwe akakwa.
Niho omweenda
guno gwaari gusuungirwe mu Hahoreeru he eriiseengerero gukaraanduka mbaara ibhiri okurwa iguru tee haasi.
Omukuru wa abhasirikare wuno yaari yiimeereeri embere wa Yeesu, hano yaruuzi kyeego Yeesu akukwa, akabhuga, “Eheene omuutu wuno yaari Omwaana wa Taatabhugya!”
Bhaari bhariho abhakari bhano bhaari bharasuungurirya kwa kure. Gati waabhu bhaari bhariho Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara, Sarome na Mariamu nina wa Yaakobo omusuuhu na Yose.
Abhakari bhayo bhaari bhamutuniiriiri no okumuhokeerya Yeesu hano yaari mumugye gwa Gariraaya. Bhaari bhariho na abhakari abhaandi bhaaru bhano bhakagya hamwe neewe Yerusaremu.
Yusufu wa Arimataya aramubhiika Yeesu
Hano yahikiri engoroobha, kwo okubha orusiku ruyo rwaari orusiku rwo okwiibhanura
kwiiguru yo orusiku rwo okumuunya,

akaaza omuutu wumwe okurwa omugye gwa Arimataya, arabhirikirwa Yusufu. Na yaari owumwe wa abhakuru mukiina ekikuru kya Abhayahudi. Yaari ariisigira obhutemi bhwa Taatabhugya. Niwe akagya ku Pirato kwo obhukararu no okumusabha amwiikiriirye agege ekituundu kya Yeesu.
Hano Pirato yiigwiiri kubha Yeesu akuuri bhwaangu ego, akaruguura. Akamubhirikira omukuru wa abhasirikare wurya, okubha amenyeekererye eraabhe eheene Yeesu amariri kukwa.
Hano omukuru wa abhasirikare yamenyeekereerye kubha Yeesu akuuri, Pirato akamwiikirirya Yusufu agege ekituundu.

Niho Yusufu neewe akagura omweenda gwo obhuguri bhukuru. Akagya kumusaraba harya, akiikya haasi ekituundu kya Yeesu, akakiriizirira mumweenda. Akabhiika ekituundu kirya mumbiihira yino ekatukwa kwiitare, akarihiriingitya eriigina eriikuru no okuriibha kukiseku kye embiihira.
Mariamu wa mumugye gwa Magidara na Mariamu nina waabhu Yaakobo omusuuhu na Yose bhakarora hano yabhiikirwe.

footnotes.text: Pirato yaari omukaangati wa Abharooma wuno akukaangata ekyaaro kya Yudea.
Manemane ni muti guno bhakumuha omuutu atiiyiigwa obhururu bhukongʼu.

Eriya aragaambwa hano kwo okubha Abhayahudi bhaaru bhaari bhariikirirya kubha Eriya ataakuuri na rumwe, nawe Taatabhugya akamugega mukyaaro eriibhaga ni muhoru no okugya neewe mwiisaaro. Kweeki bhaari bhariisiga kubha Eriya araaza kweeki mukyaaro. Rora 2 Abhatemi 2:11; Maraaki 4:5.

Omweenda gwaari guraribhira abhaatu bhatasikira Ahahoreeru ha Ahahoreeru mwiiseengerero rya Taatabhugya, hano obhuguungo bhwa Taatabhugya bhukiikara. Rora Abheeburania 9:3, 10:19-22. Rora eriiseengerero mu Bhugaruri bhwa Amangʼana Amakongʼu.
Orusiku rwo okwiibhanura rwaari Ijumaa, kwo okubha orusiku rwo okuseengera rwaari Jumamosi.
